manifest.name: dsh-ui-zoom
manifest.description: Ctrl+wheel page zoom for DeepSeek Harness (60-180%, remembered) with a layout-consistent metric shim, popovers that stay in place, a viewport height that is reclaimed rather than clipped, and a bottom-right Settings entry.

scripts.check: node --check lib/client.js && node --check lib/index.js && node scripts/smoke.mjs && node scripts/zoom.test.mjs

bundle.text:
# Bundle layer for dsh-ui-zoom: insert this plugin's own row into the
# composed cordis tree. `name` is the package specifier and must resolve
# from the profile directory; `id` is the plugin name exported by lib/index.js.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-ui-zoom
      name: dsh-ui-zoom

[中文](README.md) | [English](README.en.md)

> 一条住在 DeepSeek Harness 里的蓝色小鲸鱼，替主人把整块界面调大调小。
> 不是只把字放大——侧栏、输入框、弹层、图标一起缩放，弹层还不会跑偏。
>
> 这只蓝色的大肥鱼（误）帮主人做的小插件，用着顺手的话，给颗星星当投喂 🐋

适用于 [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的客户端插件，不改宿主代码。

---

- 🔍 **等比整体缩放（60%–180%）**：侧栏、消息、输入框、按钮、图标、间距一起变，10% 一档，不是只改字号。
- ⌨️ **三种手势**：`Ctrl` + 滚轮、`Ctrl` + `=`、`Ctrl` + `-`；`Ctrl` + `0` 一键回到 100%。
- 🎯 **浮层不错位**：DSH 用 JS 量出来的坐标（`innerWidth` / `innerHeight` / `getBoundingClientRect` / `clientX`）会同步除以缩放比，模型选择器、推理强度菜单、账户菜单都贴在原来的位置。
- 🛡️ **滚到底不会推走整页**：缩放期间锁住文档根滚动（记住原本的内联样式，回到 100% 时原样还原），消息列表滚到底继续滚，界面钉住不动。
- ⚙️ **右下角常驻「设置」**：不依赖快捷键；先调宿主的 `settings.open`，失败再走账号菜单，最后兜底合成 `Ctrl+,`。
- 💾 **记住比例**：存在 `localStorage` 的 `dsh-ui-zoom:level`，刷新和重启都还在。
- 🖥️ **终端不受影响**：`Ctrl` + 滚轮落在 xterm 上时直接放行，交给终端自己调字号。
- 🪶 **小而干净**：客户端插件，无网络请求、无文件访问，只写一个 localStorage key。

readme.section: 🎛️ 和其他缩放方案的区别
readme.text:
| 方案 | 整页缩放 | 弹层 / 输入区不错位 | 滚到底不推页 | 常驻设置入口 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 只改字号 | ✗ | — | — | — |
| 纯 CSS `zoom`（无垫片） | ✓ | ✗ 放大后弹层跑出屏幕 | ✗ | 不一定 |
| 分区缩放（只放大某几块） | 部分 | ✓ | — | 看实现 |
| **dsh-ui-zoom** | ✓ | ✓ 度量垫片 | ✓ 根滚动锁定 | ✓ |

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:sjrslh/dsh-ui-zoom
```

Web 版把 `desktop` 换成 `web`。装完按 `Ctrl + R` 或重开 DSH 生效。

readme.section: 方式 2：从 Release 下压缩包（离线 / 锁版本）
readme.text:
到 [Releases](../../releases) 下 `dsh-ui-zoom-0.4.4.tgz`，然后：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /path/to/dsh-ui-zoom-0.4.4.tgz
```

readme.section: 方式 3：克隆后本地安装（想改代码）
readme.text:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/sjrslh/dsh-ui-zoom.git
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-ui-zoom
```

改完 `lib/client.js`，`Ctrl + R` 就生效，不需要构建。

readme.section: 方式 4：手动挂进 profile（排查用）

readme.text:
| 你的情况 | 选哪个 |
|---|---|
| 只是想用 | 方式 1 |
| 公司网络连不上 GitHub / 想固定版本 | 方式 2 |
| 想改代码、提 PR | 方式 3 |
| 插件冲突排查 | 方式 4 |

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-ui-zoom
```

卸载时插件会先把缩放恢复到 100%，不会留一个放大的界面没法还原。

| 操作 | 效果 |
|---|---|
| `Ctrl` + 滚轮上 / 下 | 放大 / 缩小，10% 一档 |
| `Ctrl` + `=`（或 `+`） | 放大 10% |
| `Ctrl` + `-` | 缩小 10% |
| `Ctrl` + `0` | 回到 100% |
| 右下角「设置」 | 打开 DSH 设置面板 |

- 缩放时屏幕中间浮一个百分比胶囊，900ms 后自己消失
- 范围 60%–180%，超出会被夹住
- 滚轮有 60ms 节流，一次一格，不会跳档

```text
dsh-ui-zoom/
├─ lib/
│  ├─ index.js            # host 端入口（空实现，让包成为合法的 Cordis 插件）
│  └─ client.js           # 全部逻辑：缩放、度量垫片、滚动锁、设置按钮

**为什么不直接改字体大小？**
只改字号，按钮、图标、间距还是原来大小，界面会更挤；这里缩放的是整块布局。

**放大后弹层会不会跑到屏幕外？**
不会。浏览器原生缩放会连布局视口一起缩小，而 CSS `zoom` 只缩放绘制，所以插件把 JS 读到的尺寸同步除以缩放比，弹层和输入区按同一套坐标计算。

**为什么滚到底不会把整页推走？**
`zoom` 会把根盒子按比例放大，文档因此多出一截可滚动区域；插件在缩放时锁住根滚动，回到 100% 时把原来的样式还回去。

**会影响性能吗？**
只在缩放时设一次样式，外加一次 localStorage 写入；没有轮询、没有 MutationObserver。

**支持哪些 DSH 版本？**
`engines.dsh >= 0.1.0-rc.6`，`dshTarget 0.2.0-rc.2`。更老的版本没有 `shell.overlay` 槽位，跑不起来。
见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。最近两次：v0.3.2 修「滚到底推页」并加固垫片；v0.4.0 补 `Ctrl + =` / `Ctrl + -` 快捷键。

- 装不上 / 用不明白：先看上面的常见问题
- 能复现的问题：直接开 [issue](https://github.com/sjrslh/dsh-ui-zoom/issues/new/choose)，带上 DSH 版本和系统缩放比例
- 想聊两句：去 [Discussions](https://github.com/sjrslh/dsh-ui-zoom/discussions)
[MIT](LICENSE)。随便用，提 PR 更欢迎。

[中文](README.md) | [English](README.en.md)

> A little blue whale living inside DeepSeek Harness: it scales the whole UI for you.
> Not just the text — sidebars, composer, popovers and icons grow together, and the popovers stay where they belong.

A client plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). No host changes.

- **True page zoom, 60%–180%** in 10% steps — layout, not font size.
- **Three gestures**: `Ctrl` + wheel, `Ctrl` + `=`, `Ctrl` + `-`; `Ctrl` + `0` resets to 100%.
- **Popovers stay put**: DSH measures its shell in JS (`innerWidth` / `innerHeight` / `getBoundingClientRect` / `clientX`), so the plugin divides those values by the zoom factor too — model picker, reasoning menu and account menu land where they should.
- **No page jump at the end of a list**: while zoomed the document root scroller is locked (the previous inline styles are remembered and restored at 100%).
- **A Settings button in the bottom-right corner**: calls the host's `settings.open` first, then the account menu, then a synthetic `Ctrl + ,`.
- **Level remembered** in `localStorage` (`dsh-ui-zoom:level`).
- **Terminals are left alone**: `Ctrl` + wheel over xterm is passed through.
- **Small and quiet**: no network, no file access, one localStorage key.

| Approach | Page zoom | Popovers stay in place | No page jump | Settings button |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Font-size only | ✗ | — | — | — |
| Plain CSS `zoom` | ✓ | ✗ popovers leave the viewport | ✗ | maybe |
| Region zoom | partial | ✓ | — | depends |
| **dsh-ui-zoom** | ✓ | ✓ metric shim | ✓ root scroll lock | ✓ |

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:sjrslh/dsh-ui-zoom
```

Use `--profile web` for the web profile. Press `Ctrl + R` or restart DSH afterwards.

readme.section: Option 2 — from a release (offline / pinned version)
readme.text:
Download `dsh-ui-zoom-0.4.4.tgz` from [Releases](../../releases), then:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /path/to/dsh-ui-zoom-0.4.4.tgz
```

readme.section: Option 3 — clone and link (for hacking on it)
readme.text:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/sjrslh/dsh-ui-zoom.git
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-ui-zoom
```

Edit `lib/client.js`, press `Ctrl + R`, done — there is no build step.

| Action | Result |
|---|---|
| `Ctrl` + wheel up / down | zoom in / out, 10% per step |
| `Ctrl` + `=` (or `+`) | zoom in 10% |
| `Ctrl` + `-` | zoom out 10% |
| `Ctrl` + `0` | back to 100% |
| bottom-right **Settings** | open the DSH settings panel |

A percentage pill appears for 900 ms while zooming. The range is clamped to 60%–180%.

```text
dsh-ui-zoom/
├─ lib/
│  ├─ index.js            # host entry (empty, keeps the package a valid Cordis plugin)
│  └─ client.js           # zoom, metric shim, scroll lock, settings button

**Why not just bump the font size?** Buttons, icons and spacing would stay the same and the UI would get cramped; this scales the whole layout.

**Do popovers drift after zooming?** No. Native browser zoom shrinks the layout viewport; CSS `zoom` only scales paint, so the plugin divides the JS-visible metrics by the zoom factor to keep both in the same coordinate space.

**Why does the page no longer slide at the end of a list?** `zoom` enlarges the root box, so the document gains a scrollable strip; the plugin locks the root scroller while zoomed and restores the previous styles at 100%.

**Performance?** One style write per zoom step and one localStorage write. No polling, no observers.

**DSH versions?** `engines.dsh >= 0.1.0-rc.6`, `dshTarget 0.2.0-rc.2`. Older builds have no `shell.overlay` slot.
